# aidial_translator (Data Source)

Reads an existing translator stored in DIAL Core resource storage without managing it. Use `aidial_file_translator` for translators defined in static (file) configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A translator stored in DIAL Core resource storage, for example one managed
# elsewhere with the aidial_translator resource.
data "aidial_translator" "claude" {
  bucket = "platform"
  path   = "openai-to-claude"
}

output "translator_base_url" {
  value = data.aidial_translator.claude.base_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) DIAL bucket. Must be "platform".
- `path` (String) Translator path inside the bucket.

### Read-Only

- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the translator service.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the form <bucket>/<path>.
- `in` (String) Incoming interface type. One of `openaiChatCompletions`, `openaiEmbeddings`, `openaiResponses`, `anthropicMessages`.
- `out` (String) Outgoing interface type. One of `openaiChatCompletions`, `openaiEmbeddings`, `openaiResponses`, `anthropicMessages`.
